newsitem.title: USA: Deluxe closes sale of Colwell to Patterson.
newsitem.headline: Deluxe closes sale of Colwell to Patterson.

text.p: Deluxe Corp said Wednesday it has completed the sale of its Colwell health care forms business to Patterson Dental Co. Details of the sale were not disclosed.

Patterson Dental, based in St. Paul, is the largest distributor of dental products in North America. Patterson had sales of $582 million for its fiscal year ending April 27, 1996. Colwell, with manufacturing sites in Champaign, Ill., had 1995 sales of about $55 million.

The sale is part of Deluxe's recently announced intention to focus on providing paper and electronic products and services, database marketing, and other information solutions primarily to U.S. and international financial institutions and retailers.
Shares of Deluxe were trading up 3/8 to 38-1/4.
